claims.text: Audiovisual access: In its decision summary dated 16 April 2026 (06122-2/2026/2), AKOS reported that it had checked accessibility features on a computer in two catch-up news programmes on Radiotelevizija Slovenija’s web service. It found that the subtitles, spoken subtitles and sign-language interpretation it checked complied with ZDPSI and the relevant accessibility regulation. This finding concerns the tested features and programmes.
claims.legal_basis: ZDPSI Article 10(1),second indent, and regulation on accessibility of services providing access to audiovisual media services
claims.action_type: Officially reported monitoring or complaint activity
claims.stage_detail: Summary supports limited inspection findings. Does not establish whole-platform compliance, full operative closure text, or absence of other cases. Source names web service RTV 356; public wording avoids silently correcting that name.
